queries.sql:
WITH gross AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents - oi.discount_cents) AS gross_sales_cents
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status != 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY month
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', r.return_date) AS month,
        SUM(r.refund_cents) AS total_refund_cents
    FROM returns r
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
    g.month,
    g.gross_sales_cents,
    COALESCE(r.total_refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
    g.gross_sales_cents - COALESCE(r.total_refund_cents, 0) AS net_sales_cents
FROM gross g
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON g.month = r.month
ORDER BY g.month

)
SELECT 
    g.store_id,
    g.gross_sales_cents,
    COALESCE(r.total_refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
    g.gross_sales_cents - COALESCE(r.total_refund_cents, 0) AS net_sales_cents
FROM gross g
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON g.store_id = r.store_id

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
        p.product_name,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_qty,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents - oi.discount_cents) AS gross_sales_cents
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_id IN (3, 4) AND o.status != 'cancelled'
      AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) >= '2026-05'
    GROUP BY month, p.product_name
),
ret AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', r.return_date) AS month,
        p.product_name,
        SUM(r.returned_quantity) AS returned_qty,
        SUM(r.refund_cents) AS refunds_cents
    FROM returns r
    JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_id IN (3, 4)
      AND strftime('%Y-%m', r.return_date) >= '2026-05'
    GROUP BY month, p.product_name
)
SELECT 
    s.month,
    s.product_name,
    s.sold_qty,
    COALESCE(r.returned_qty, 0) AS returned_qty,
    s.gross_sales_cents,
    COALESCE(r.refunds_cents, 0) AS refunds_cents,
    ROUND(COALESCE(r.returned_qty, 0)*100.0/s.sold_qty, 1) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN ret r ON s.month = r.month AND s.product_name = r.product_name
ORDER BY s.month, s.product_name
